voice: edge-tts en-US-AnaNeural, pitch +12Hz, rate -4%, light echo

clips.caption: Cadet! I want to learn about Earth. Show me what you love! Pick ten things!
clips.trigger: Show when the 'Pick what you love' interest picker opens (first run, right after the intro video).

clips.caption: Wow! Earth is amazing! I can't wait to read about those!
clips.trigger: Play after the cadet confirms 10+ interest picks, before going to the ship bridge.

clips.caption: You're back, Cadet! Ready for today's mission?
clips.trigger: Play on the ship bridge home screen when a returning cadet opens the app (once per day/session).

clips.caption: A new story! Let's crack the code together!
clips.trigger: Play when a new story is opened, before page 1.

clips.caption: You cracked it!
clips.trigger: Play when a cadet decodes/reads a tricky word correctly (short; OK to reuse often, or play the MP3 alone).

clips.caption: That one was tricky. Let's sound it out together!
clips.trigger: Play after 2+ missed attempts on a word in the decoder, then open the sound-out slider.

clips.caption: You did it! Our ship has more fuel!
clips.trigger: Play on the story-finished screen when fuel / star credits are awarded.

clips.caption: A new planet! Let's go explore!
clips.trigger: Play when enough stories are finished to unlock a new planet on the map.

clips.caption: Cadet, you've been promoted!
clips.trigger: Play when the cadet earns a new rank (promotion screen).
